title: Three Mondays and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：knowledge　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 knowledge 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the teacher ① tested the knowledge that no pupil in the school would have recorded, and he said the testing was the whole of the Monday. The ② knowledge, meaning the fact itself and not the lamp, ran three Mondays and stayed unrecorded in the book; knowledge, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of knowledge in that school had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ knowledge at the far desk, meaning the page they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Knowledge, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the teacher said the recording is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the knowledge was the whole of the matter, meaning the habit and not the fact. The ⑥ knowledge, meaning the habit and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; knowledge, he said, is either something you test or the only word that means both fact and a habit. He said the habit is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ knowledge had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ knowledge of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in September, was one school and three Mondays of recording; knowledge, he said, is either the page at the far desk or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ knowledge I remember is the knowledge recorded in the report, which closed in 1974 and is still recorded as the quietest in the school. ⑩ Knowledge, my mother said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all knowledge, she said, is a habit that has agreed to look like fact. She said the habit was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 知识；学问（指学堂里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 知识；学问（指那点知识本身，与油灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：test the knowledge 考查这些知识
D. n. 知识；学问（指留给孩子们抄下的那一页那一点）
E. n. 求学之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的知识之事）
F. n. 知识；学问（指报告里写到、被记载的的那一点）
G. n. 习惯、素养（指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 素养（抽象总称，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: test the knowledge 意为“考查这些知识”，1967 年那位教书先生把学堂里没有一位学童肯记载的一点知识做了一遍。
knowledge 意为“知识；学问”，指那点知识本身而不是油灯，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被记载。
knowledge 意为“知识；学问”，指学堂里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一盏小小的油灯。
knowledge 意为“知识；学问”，指最远那张课桌留给孩子们抄下的那一页那一点，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
knowledge 意为“习惯、素养”，指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份素养就是那件事的全部。
knowledge 意为“素养”，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西而不是那点知识，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
knowledge 意为“知识；学问”，指报告里写到、被记载的的那一点，到 1972 年这一点成了报告里的一行。
knowledge 意为“求学之事”，教书先生九月写道，整件事的知识之事是一处学堂和三个星期一的记载。
knowledge 意为“知识；学问”，我记得的是报告里记载过的那一点，1974 年考完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一点。
knowledge 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，知识是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的知识。
